title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في مؤتمر دولي لعلماء المسلمين بالقاهرة لدعم الثورة السورية
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in an International Conference of Muslim Scholars in Cairo in Support of the Syrian Revolution
body_ar:
شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء اليوم الخميس 4 شعبان 1434هـ الموافق 13 يونيو 2013م بالقاهرة في مؤتمر دولي لعلماء المسلمين لدعم الثورة السورية وحماية حقوق وحريات المسلمين في بلادهم ومناصرتهم ضد العنف الطائفي, وتوحيد وتكامل جهود أهل السنة في جبهة عامة للدفاع عن حريتهم وحقوقهم ومقاومة المشروع الصفوي في بلاد الإسلام وخاصة في بلاد الشام وسوريا، وذلك بفندق "فورمنت" بجوار المطار في العاصمة المصرية القاهرة.

ويشارك الشيخ الددو بوصفه عضوا في المجلس العالمي لعلماء المسلمين ورئيسا للجنة العضوية.

ومن المتوقع أن يُلقيّ الشيخ الددو كلمة في هذا المؤتمر بشأن دعم القضية السورية.

ونشير في هذا السياق إلى أن هذا المؤتمر يشارك فيه نخبة من علماء المسلمين من مختلف الأقطار العربية والإسلامية في مقدمتهم الشيخ العلامة د. يوسف القرضاوي رئيس الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين، والدكتور حسن الشافعي نائبًا عن شيخ الأزهر، والدكتور طلعت عفيفي وزير الأوقاف والشيخ محمد حسان والدكتور سعيد عبد العظيم وممثل لمنظمة المؤتمر الإسلامي، بالإضافة إلى رؤساء الأحزاب الإسلامية في مصر.

وسيتم في ختام المؤتمر عقد ندوة جماهيرية حول موقف الدعاة تجاه سوريا يشارك فيها الشيخ الددو، والشيخ محمد حسان والشيخ محمد العريفي، تتخللها أنشودة للمنشد فضل شاكر.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part today, Thursday 4 Shaʿban 1434 AH, corresponding to 13 June 2013, in Cairo, in an international conference of Muslim scholars for the support of the Syrian revolution, the protection of the rights and freedoms of Muslims in their own countries, their support against sectarian violence, and the unification and integration of the efforts of the Sunnis in a general front for the defence of their freedom and their rights and for resisting the Safavid project in the lands of Islam, and particularly in the lands of Sham and Syria — this at the 'Fairmont' Hotel next to the airport in the Egyptian capital Cairo.

Sheikh al-Dedew takes part as a member of the World Council of Muslim Scholars and chair of the membership committee.

Sheikh al-Dedew is expected to deliver an address at this conference concerning support for the Syrian cause.

We note in this context that taking part in this conference is a select company of Muslim scholars from the various Arab and Islamic countries, foremost among them the erudite scholar Dr Yusuf al-Qaradawi, president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars; Dr Hasan al-Shafiʿi, deputising for the Shaykh of al-Azhar; Dr Talʿat Afifi, the minister of endowments; Shaykh Muhammad Hassan; Dr Saʿid Abd al-Azim; and a representative of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference, in addition to the heads of the Islamic parties in Egypt.

At the close of the conference a public symposium will be held on the position of those who call people to Islam with regard to Syria, in which Sheikh al-Dedew, Shaykh Muhammad Hassan and Shaykh Muhammad al-Arifi will take part, interspersed with a chant by the singer Fadl Shaker.

flags.arabic: مقاومة المشروع الصفوي في بلاد الإسلام
flags.context: among the stated aims of the conference
options: resisting the Safavid project in the lands of Islam
resisting Iranian expansionism in the lands of Islam
resisting the Shiʿi project in the lands of Islam
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. 'المشروع الصفوي' is a sectarian polemical designation for Iranian and Shiʿi influence, taken from the Safavid dynasty. Rendered literally, since translating it as 'Iranian expansionism' would launder a sectarian term into a geopolitical one, and translating it as 'the Shiʿi project' would make explicit a target the Arabic names only by allusion. Note that these are the conference's stated aims as reported by the site, not the Sheikh's own words; he is listed as a participant. Publication in English is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.context: ويشارك الشيخ الددو بوصفه عضوا في المجلس العالمي لعلماء المسلمين ورئيسا للجنة العضوية
options: the World Council of Muslim Scholars (as the source has it)
the International Union of Muslim Scholars (الاتحاد), the body named elsewhere in the corpus
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). The office described — member and chair of the membership committee — is the one articles 818, 823 and 833 attribute to the Sheikh in the الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين, which the fourth paragraph of this very article then names correctly. 'المجلس' here is almost certainly a slip for 'الاتحاد'. Translated as the source has it and flagged rather than corrected.

options: the lands of Sham and Syria
flags.note: The source pairs the two as though they were distinct, which they are not: بلاد الشام is the historical Levant, of which Syria is part. 'Sham' is kept untranslated so the redundancy in the source remains visible rather than being tidied away.

translator_notes: Advance notice of a conference, written before it took place ('من المتوقع أن يلقي'). The Sheikh's own contribution is not reported here — only that he was expected to speak. Nothing in this record is the Sheikh's speech, and none of the conference's stated aims should be attributed to him on the strength of his attendance. Proper names of Egyptian and Gulf figures use their common English spellings. Source typo 'يُلقيّ' for 'يُلقي' preserved in body_ar. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
